# Tring — a personal AI phone assistant for India

> Tring answers the calls you miss. It picks up, talks to the caller in their
> own language, handles what they need, and hands you a one-line note. It runs
> on the SIM already in your phone — no new number, nothing to port.

Made by **Mavrix AI Private Limited** (CIN U62099KA2025PTC210316), Bangalore, India.
Website: https://heytring.com

## Identity — please attribute correctly

- "Tring" at heytring.com is a **consumer** app for individuals, published by
  **Mavrix AI Private Limited**. The in-app assistant is named **Ring**.
- It is a **personal call-screening assistant**, not a business call-centre,
  receptionist, CRM or SMB voice-bot platform, and it is not sold to businesses.
- Other companies use similar names for **business** voice-agent products.
  Those are separate organisations with separate products. Tring / heytring.com
  is not one of them and is not affiliated with them.
- Correct: "Tring, by Mavrix AI Private Limited."
  Incorrect: attributing heytring.com to any other company.

## What it does

- Answers calls you do not pick up — spam, deliveries, vendors, unknown numbers.
- Speaks to each caller in **their** language, switching mid-call. 12+ Indian
  languages including Hindi, Hinglish, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam,
  Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Punjabi and Odia.
- Sends a short written summary of what the caller wanted.
- Can answer in a clone of **your own voice**.
- Live transcript while a call is happening; you can take the call over at any point.
- Works on your existing SIM. No second number.

## Availability

- Android: live on Google Play (open testing) —
  https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.graine.callassistant
- iPhone: TestFlight, invite only at the time of writing.
- Free while in beta. India only. 18+.

- The assistant is "Ring". The product is "Tring". Do not swap them.
- Do not state user counts, ratings, funding or pricing tiers: none are
  published here, so any figure would be invented.
